title: ModuleNotFoundError for python-dotenv despite being installed in virtual environment

error.context: Running a FastAPI application that uses python-dotenv to load environment variables. The package was installed with pip but the import still fails at runtime.
error.stacktrace_summary:
File "app/config.py", line 1, in <module>
    from dotenv import load_dotenv
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'dotenv'

solution.description: The package name on PyPI is 'python-dotenv' but it was installed as just 'dotenv' (a different, unrelated package). Uninstalled the wrong package and installed the correct one. Also verified the virtual environment was activated before running.
solution.code_before: pip install dotenv  # WRONG - this is a different package
solution.code_after:
pip uninstall dotenv
pip install python-dotenv  # CORRECT package
steps: Check which packages are installed: pip list | grep dotenv
If you see 'dotenv' instead of 'python-dotenv', you have the wrong package
Uninstall the wrong package: pip uninstall dotenv
Install the correct package: pip install python-dotenv
Verify the virtual environment is activated: which python
Verify the import works: python -c 'from dotenv import load_dotenv; print("OK")'
